title: Apply cyber security controls to information assets
description: Organizations must implement cybersecurity controls to safeguard their information assets from threats and vulnerabilities.

title: Apply cyber security controls to information storage devices
description: Organizations must implement cybersecurity controls to secure information storage devices, such as hard disks and USB sticks, against unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Improve cyber security controls
description: Organizations must continuously improve their cybersecurity controls in alignment with the principles and objectives defined in the SAMA Cyber Security Framework.

title: Initiate cyber security controls
description: Ensure that foundational cyber security controls are established to protect the organization from cyber threats.

title: Maintain cyber security controls
description: Ensure that existing cyber security controls are regularly reviewed and updated to remain effective.

title: Monitor cyber security controls
description: Ensure that cyber security controls are continuously monitored to detect and respond to potential issues.

title: Provide direction for cyber security requirements for subsidiaries
description: Ensure that subsidiaries comply with the organization's cyber security requirements.

title: Mandate framework adoption by SAMA
description: Ensure compliance with the mandatory adoption of the SAMA Cyber Security Framework.

title: Update the framework periodically
description: Ensure that the framework is reviewed and updated periodically to address emerging threats and changes.

title: Review the framework periodically
description: Conduct regular reviews of the framework to ensure it remains effective and aligned with organizational and regulatory requirements.

title: Submit framework update requests formally
description: Member organizations should use a formal process to request updates to the framework when necessary.

title: Update the framework based on review outcomes
description: Make necessary updates to the framework based on findings from periodic reviews to address gaps or changes in requirements.

title: Perform self-assessment based on a questionnaire
description: Use a standardized questionnaire to guide the self-assessment process and ensure consistency.

title: SAMA to review and audit self-assessments
description: SAMA will review and audit the self-assessments to verify compliance and assess the organization's cybersecurity maturity.

title: Measure cyber security maturity level
description: Use a predefined model to measure and evaluate the organization's cybersecurity maturity level.

title: Ensure cyber security documentation includes 'why', 'what', and 'how'
description: Ensure that cyber security documentation provides clear reasoning, scope, and implementation details for controls.

title: Establish cyber security policies, standards, and procedures
description: Develop and maintain comprehensive cyber security policies, standards, and procedures to guide organizational practices.

title: Monitor compliance with cyber security documentation
description: Regularly monitor and assess adherence to established cyber security documentation to ensure compliance.

title: Use KRIs for trend reporting and improvement identification
description: Leverage KRIs to identify trends and areas for improvement in cyber security practices.

title: Appoint a full-time senior manager (CISO) for cyber security
description: Ensure the appointment of a qualified, full-time CISO to oversee the organization's cyber security function.

title: Develop and approve a cyber security committee charter
description: Create and formally approve a charter that defines the purpose, structure, and responsibilities of the cyber security committee.

title: Ensure CISO has Saudi nationality and is qualified
description: Verify that the appointed CISO is a Saudi national and possesses the necessary qualifications for the role.

title: Ensure cyber security function is independent from IT
description: Establish a cyber security function that operates independently from the IT department to avoid conflicts of interest.

title: Implement security requirements for information assets
description: Organizations must ensure that the defined security requirements for information assets are put into practice.

title: Define cyber security requirements in HR processes
description: HR processes should define specific cyber security requirements relevant to their operations.

title: Implement cyber security requirements in HR processes
description: HR processes should ensure that defined cyber security requirements are implemented effectively.

title: Measure and evaluate HR process effectiveness
description: Organizations should periodically assess the effectiveness of HR processes in meeting cyber security requirements.

title: Monitor effectiveness of HR processes
description: Organizations should monitor the ongoing effectiveness of HR processes in meeting cyber security requirements.

title: Measure and evaluate effectiveness of payment systems standard
description: Regularly assess the effectiveness of the payment systems cyber security standard.

title: Measure and evaluate physical security process effectiveness
description: Regularly assess the performance of physical security measures to ensure they meet objectives and identify areas for improvement.

title: Monitor effectiveness of physical security process
description: Continuously monitor physical security measures to detect and respond to potential weaknesses or breaches.

title: Measure and evaluate cloud security controls
description: Assess the performance of cloud security controls to ensure they meet objectives and identify areas for improvement.

title: Measure and evaluate third-party secure disposal effectiveness
description: Assess the effectiveness of third-party secure disposal processes to ensure compliance and adequacy.

title: Provide strategic direction for cyber security
description: The organization should define and communicate a strategic plan for its cybersecurity initiatives.

title: Verify responsible use of enterprise resources
description: Ensure that enterprise resources, such as IT systems, data, and personnel, are utilized in a manner that aligns with organizational policies and objectives.

title: Employ techniques for continuous monitoring of security state
description: Implement tools and processes to continuously monitor the security posture of the organization's information systems.

title: Implement a risk mitigation strategy
description: Develop and execute a strategy to reduce identified risks to an acceptable level.

title: Define information security roles and responsibilities
description: Clearly define and document roles and responsibilities for information security within the organization.

title: Facilitate and monitor implementation of effective information security practices
description: Oversee and track the adoption of information security practices by operational teams to ensure effectiveness.

title: Identify known and emerging information security issues
description: Continuously identify and document both existing and emerging security threats to the organization.

title: Identify shifts in the organization's implicit information risk appetite
description: Monitor and document changes in the organization's tolerance for information security risks.

title: Provide guidance and training on information security and risk management
description: Deliver training and guidance to employees on information security and risk management to ensure awareness and compliance.

title: Provide information security and risk management frameworks
description: Develop and provide structured frameworks for managing information security and associated risks.

title: Set information security goals for implementation
description: Define clear and measurable goals for implementing information security initiatives.

title: Support information security policies
description: Ensure that information security policies are supported, roles and responsibilities are defined, and goals are established.

title: Define service level agreements (SLAs)
description: Establish SLAs with service providers to define responsibilities and set clear expectations.

title: Establish a risk register
description: Maintain a centralized repository to document, track, and manage identified risks and their mitigation plans.

title: Establish a security operations center (SOC)
description: Set up a dedicated team and infrastructure to monitor, detect, and respond to security incidents in real-time.

title: Implement red-teaming exercises
description: Conduct simulated attacks to test the organization's ability to detect, respond to, and recover from security incidents.

title: Implement risk treatment processes
description: Develop and implement strategies to address identified risks, including mitigation, transfer, or acceptance.

title: Implement sandboxing for controlled execution
description: Use sandboxing to isolate and analyze potentially malicious software in a controlled environment.

title: Implement SIEM tools for security data gathering
description: Deploy SIEM tools to collect, analyze, and correlate security data for real-time monitoring and incident response.

title: Implement vulnerability management practices
description: Establish a process to regularly identify, assess, and remediate vulnerabilities in the organization's systems and applications.

title: Mitigate negative consequences of risks
description: This control ensures that risks with negative consequences are addressed through appropriate mitigation strategies to reduce their impact.

title: Perform security testing of information systems
description: This control ensures that security testing is conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of safeguards protecting information systems.

title: Promote a risk-aware culture
description: This control ensures that the organization fosters a culture where employees are aware of and take responsibility for managing risks.

title: Recover to effective operational posture
description: This control ensures that the organization can recover operations effectively within a timeframe that supports its mission.

title: Assess security-related data in SOC
description: This control ensures that the SOC evaluates security-related data to identify potential threats or vulnerabilities.

title: Detect indicators of compromise in SOC
description: This control ensures that the SOC is focused on identifying indicators of compromise to detect potential security incidents.

title: Disseminate security-related information from SOC
description: This control ensures that the SOC shares security-related information with relevant stakeholders within the organization.

title: Investigate indicators of compromise in SOC
description: This control ensures that the SOC investigates indicators of compromise to determine the nature and scope of potential security incidents.

title: Monitor security-related data in SOC
description: The Security Operations Center (SOC) must continuously monitor security-related data from all enterprise systems to detect potential threats or anomalies.

title: Provide an overview of threats and trends
description: Organizations must maintain an up-to-date overview of current and emerging threats and trends to inform risk management strategies.

title: Ensure third-party providers adhere to security standards
description: Organizations must ensure that third-party providers comply with the same security standards and requirements as the organization itself.

title: Identify vulnerabilities
description: Organizations must identify vulnerabilities in their systems, applications, and networks to address potential risks.

title: Mitigate vulnerabilities
description: Organizations must implement measures to mitigate identified vulnerabilities and reduce associated risks.

title: Remediate vulnerabilities
description: Organizations must remediate vulnerabilities by applying fixes or patches to eliminate risks.
